display_name: Snapdeal formula pattern — Return ↔ OMS Reconciliation
formula_sql:
SELECT
  r.order_id,
  r.invoice_number AS return_credit_note,
  r.charged_amount AS return_amount,
  o.charged_amount AS original_order_amount,
  o.current_order_state
FROM zs_observe.snapdeal_sales_return r
LEFT JOIN zs_observe.snapdeal_oms o
  ON r.sub_order_no = o.suborder_code
  AND o.is_active = true
WHERE r.is_active = true;
